annotations.title: Add a custom domain to a site

description: Add a custom domain to a hosted site. It starts as pending, and the answer gives two DNS records: a TXT record that proves control of the domain, and a CNAME record that sends its traffic to SHIP. The domain goes live after SHIP finds the TXT record and the certificate is active. Needs a paid plan. This tool calls the SHIP API, documented at https://letsship.ai/docs/api. Requires the config:write capability.
